title: skills: platform-readings.md still says D9 system-write stamping reads PLATFORM_OBJECT_TENANCY tenant-scoped (the ledger is gone; the rule is a tenant column, not federated)
body:
Carrier for **item 5 of #25203**, split out so that card can close when its engine items land. The `domain:engine` seat routed this item to the skills lane at dispatch (the engine lane does not edit `.claude/**`); this card is its carrier.
- **Who acts:** `domain:skills`.
- **Dedupe:** item 5 of #25203 (epic seat note 6342226941); no other carrier.

Part of #15212.

## What is on `main`
`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md:403` (at `8dfd1265f`):

> 租户普查 `reach: in` 只说有租户列;D9 系统写盖章只认 `PLATFORM_OBJECT_TENANCY` 的 `tenant-scoped`。

The second half has been false since ADR-0131 stage 8b, and the `PLATFORM_OBJECT_TENANCY` ledger is deleted: since #25210 the engine decides D9 stamping (and the isSystem audit mute) by schema — the object has a tenant column and is not federated.

## Wanted
- Reword the second half to the schema rule: D9 system-write stamping follows the object's schema (a tenant column, not federated); no ledger.
- Keep the line's first half and the file's one-fact-per-line shape.

## Acceptance
- The line no longer names `PLATFORM_OBJECT_TENANCY`; `git grep PLATFORM_OBJECT_TENANCY -- .claude` finds no live claim that the ledger decides stamping.
- `.claude/**` is a governed surface (`claude-tree`): landing follows that row.
